review.scope: RIGHT shoulder selected source structures; not a complete joint model
review.visual_gate: Reviewer-inspected static visual acceptance, scoped selected RIGHT regional study
source_gaps: Rotator cuff/muscles/bursae not included in this ligament-labrum study.
review.source_frame: Z native evaluated world only; no BP3D/CT placement
review.failure: Isolated tiny whole-body joint marks did not support regional structural inspection.
review.cause: Global framing plus missing named key and occlusion obscured relationships; procedural geometry had weak source grounding.
review.fix: Named source geometry in regional context; exact exported GLB views, opaque selected-structure focus and EN/中文 numbered source-vertex keys.
review.retest: Final-GLB anterior/lateral/posterior/deep/focus renders. Names, roles, finite coordinates, polygon-surface bounds and triangulated topology checked against source.
review.lesson: Show the structure in context, then remove named occluders explicitly. Real source can still contain gaps and topology defects; neither source reputation nor a pretty render validates mechanics.
reference_checks: Z-Anatomy original named objects and evaluated shapes; exact source hash recorded.
Linked OpenStax selected-synovial-joints chapter used for high-level structural comparison only; no text/figures redistributed.
review.evidence: review-contact-sheet.png; raw unannotated render files retained

historicalRecordPolicy: Original historical record retained unchanged in frozen handoff; public summary normalized for readability.
